mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1% over the prior month, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0% for two consecutive months, it signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction permits (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate broad-based demand contraction that triggers equity sell-offs, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS decline by at least 0.5% from prior month, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During manufacturing supply chain disruptions (INDPRO below 95.0), a decline in industrial production signals reduced output capacity that suppresses corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO < 95.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that triggers hawkish monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction permits (HOUST) over three months indicates rising housing demand that boosts consumer confidence and corporate capital expenditure, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where HOUST increases by at least 0.5% from prior month, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicate labor market deterioration that reduces disposable income and consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises by at least 0.1% from prior month, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 95.0 for two consecutive months, it signals manufacturing slowdown that reduces corporate output and profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window < 0.03.
